verdict.rationale: Signifyd is a SaaS fraud-protection platform, so a built-in AI assistant is a fair question to ask of it. However, nothing in the evidence pack describes an in-product assistant that users can delegate tasks to. The material covers only REST APIs, webhooks, SDKs, device profiling, and Decision Center policies, none of which is a conversational or agentic assistant.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product
